title: 2D Sprites
author: FredrickVilhelm
selftext:
I am making a game that has a 2D top down basic dungeon crawling design. I’m using Claude and ChatGPT. ChatGPT has been making my art and Claude converts it. But no matter how I phrase the prompt the art becomes awkward when putting through Claude. Not like super unrecognizable but not exactly clean. The pixel sizes range from 64x32 to 32x32 down to 24x24. 

Anyone have any success with chaptgpt making good sprites or have a website that I can get free usable sprites that look cleaner. 

Any advice helps!

comments.author: ludus-ex-machina
comments.body: I faced the same problem and got good results using NanoBanana. I have Claude craft scripts, which I then run through the terminal, and pass the the Google image generation API. If you ask, Claude will walk you through set up. Will cost you in tokens with Google, but results have been great for sprite sheets.

comments.author: TalkingPixelsStudio
comments.body: If you don't find a solution your welcome to use my pixel forge sprite editor tool. I haven't used it in awhile so I would have to dig it up so lmk if it's needed. Might work for you might not but the options there if ya need it

comments.author: crackedpotstudio
comments.body: Pixellab mcp with an agent checking the artwork is the way to go

comments.author: QuantumWhisker
comments.body:
Just try to steer away from using an image model and look for alternatives where you can still get hands on control of what is being created, like code. 

I even created a full drawing app to be able to get that control back..
